title: BetterReflection enum adapter backing type wrapper

ground_truth.statement: The BetterReflection enum adapter returns its own ReflectionNamedType wrapper for a backed enum, and null for a unit enum. The library-specific wrapper satisfies the native consumer contract.

notes: This candidate requires the actual adapter library. composer.lock pins the direct and transitive dependencies. Run tools/install.sh on a fresh checkout; missing declared dependencies are a case error, not an analyzer finding. The runtime checks both backed and unit enums using the installed adapter, not a mock or copied adapter stub. All three pinned analyzers accept this reduced semantic contract; its independent runtime controls pass. Mago must index the actual library through source.includes; missing-class reports from the initial unindexed run were configuration errors and disappear with the committed configuration. composer.json pins transitive parser and stub versions as well as the adapter.
